title: Matthew 25:1-13
subtitle: 32nd Sunday in Ordinary Time · Wis 6:12-16; 1 Thes 4:13-18; Mt 25:1-13
text: Ten bridesmaids waited for a delayed bridegroom, and all of them fell asleep; the wise ones were simply prepared. Oil cannot be borrowed at midnight: prayer, charity and the sacraments are stored up day by day. Stay awake, for you know neither the day nor the hour.
imageAlt: Five calm women in pale robes holding lit lamps stand at left while one points; the foolish virgins kneel and plead at right beneath a dark sky with an angel blowing a trumpet.
credit: William Blake, The Parable of the Wise and Foolish Virgins, c. 1799–1800, The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York. CC0 (public domain), via Wikimedia Commons
